disclaimer: These profiles are research abstractions for testing director/style separation. They are not generated images, rendered videos, or verbatim private style recipes.

input_contract.target_backend: unresolved until a real A/B run is authorized

locked_invariants.label: 原意与事实边界
locked_invariants.rule: Preserve the source claim, narrative route, and non-fabrication boundary.

locked_invariants.label: 旁白与节拍
locked_invariants.rule: Preserve the approved voiceover text and its 0–3s, 3–7s, and 7–10s beat assignment.

locked_invariants.label: 六幕职责
locked_invariants.rule: Preserve each scene purpose and its place in the six-scene narrative arc.

locked_invariants.label: 首尾连续性
locked_invariants.rule: Preserve the semantic first-frame inheritance and final-frame handoff, while translating their appearance into the selected style.

locked_invariants.label: 版本与批准谱系
locked_invariants.rule: Reference the approved director revision and create a separate visual revision; never overwrite the director approval.

approval_policy.director_approval: Valid until source, voiceover, scene structure, aspect ratio, or global narrative intent changes.
approval_policy.visual_approval: Valid only for one style profile plus director revision. Changing style invalidates visual approval but keeps director approval.
approval_policy.production_gate: A backend-ready production contract requires both approvals and a resolved backend adapter.

style_profiles.fit: 知识解释、产品逻辑、数据感较强但不依赖画内文字的内容

style_overrides.subject_language: Editorial silhouettes and precise geometric figures with generous negative space; no stick-figure anatomy lock.
style_overrides.surface_and_background: Clean pale ice-blue field, crisp flat layers, restrained translucent panels, no paper grain.
style_overrides.palette_semantics: Ice blue indicates explanation and flow; charcoal anchors subjects; cool gray supports secondary structure.
style_overrides.camera_and_motion: Measured lateral slides, diagram-like reveals, clean match cuts, restrained parallax, no restless handheld motion.
style_overrides.vfx: Thin vectors, masks, grids, and controlled translucent wipes used only when they explain the idea.
style_overrides.negative_constraints: No warm color contamination, decorative clutter, photorealism, random text, glossy 3D, or expressive cartoon deformation.

model_adapter.reference_strategy: One approved keyframe per scene plus a global palette/shape reference board.
model_adapter.fallback: If reference conditioning is unavailable, render static keyframes first and use image-to-video.

qa_gates: negative space remains readable at delivery crop
ice-blue palette stays consistent across six clips
diagram motion still expresses the approved scene purpose
no unintended words, numbers, logos, or interface labels

style_profiles.fit: 情绪递进、心理冲突、警示、力量感与高反差品牌叙事

style_overrides.subject_language: Graphic fashion silhouettes and cropped human gestures; preserve identity through outline, proportion, and a recurring red signature shape.
style_overrides.surface_and_background: Near-black field with matte charcoal planes and controlled red light; texture remains subtle and non-photographic.
style_overrides.palette_semantics: Red marks pressure, rupture, and decisive action; bone white marks release or clarity; black owns the frame.
style_overrides.camera_and_motion: Tight crops, slow pressure pushes, abrupt red wipes, directional match cuts, and deliberate freeze-before-impact beats.
style_overrides.vfx: Red slashes, bars, shadow blocks, and particulate traces that inherit the approved continuity object.
style_overrides.negative_constraints: No cheerful pastel color, generic neon cyberpunk, horror gore, illegible crushed detail, random typography, or uncontrolled flicker.

model_adapter.reference_strategy: Global character silhouette sheet, red signature-shape board, and explicit first/final frame references.
model_adapter.fallback: Reduce character close-ups and express continuity through red shapes if identity conditioning is weak.

qa_gates: red remains semantic rather than decorative
character outline and recurring red shape remain stable
no unintended horror, gore, typography, or strobing

style_profiles.fit: 文化、旅行、诗意知识、人文叙事与缓慢建立的情绪内容

style_overrides.subject_language: Simplified hand-painted figures and landscape-shaped objects; identity is carried by silhouette, costume block, and one recurring object.
style_overrides.surface_and_background: Layered mineral blue-green planes on a warm pale ground with restrained brush-edge variation.
style_overrides.palette_semantics: Blue-green establishes space and continuity; muted mineral gold marks insight or transition; dark ink anchors hierarchy.
style_overrides.camera_and_motion: Slow planar drift, scroll-like reveal, foreground veil, depth compression, and object-led dissolves without ornamental wandering.
style_overrides.vfx: Mist bands, ink-edge masks, mineral-color blooms, and paper-cut parallax tied to the narrative beat.
style_overrides.negative_constraints: No added symbols, architecture, calligraphy, costumes, or historical claims not present in the approved source; no generic fantasy spectacle.

model_adapter.reference_strategy: Approved scene keyframes plus a restrained material and palette board; continuity prioritizes object and spatial layer order.
model_adapter.fallback: Use layered 2.5D keyframes and controlled camera motion when native video generation changes material or identity.

qa_gates: no unapproved cultural symbol or historical assertion is introduced
blue-green material and spatial layer order remain stable
motion preserves the approved beat instead of becoming decorative
recurring object survives every transition handoff
